column3: NASB follows the critical text (“your apostles”); “declarations” is rendered “words,” and NASB supplies “that you should” and “spoken.”
NASB follows the critical text (“with their mocking”); “scoffers” is rendered “mockers,” and “desires” “lusts.”
“It is concealed willingly” is rendered “when they maintain this, it escapes their notice”; “composed” is rendered “formed.”
NASB has “His word,” which matches the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “the same word.”
“Should not be hidden from you” is rendered “do not let … escape your notice”; NASB supplies “fact.”
NASB follows the critical text (“toward you”); “delay” is rendered “is not slow about.”
NASB follows the critical text, without “in the night,” but it reads “will be burned up” with the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “will be found” (laid bare).
NASB follows the critical text (“in this way”); NASB supplies “people.”
“Expecting” is rendered “looking for,” and “through which” “on account of which.”
NASB supplies “since”; “without spot and without blemish” is rendered “spotless and blameless.”
NASB follows the critical text (“in which”); “ignorant” is rendered “untaught,” and “the other” “the rest of.”
“Beware” is rendered “be on your guard,” and “lawless” “unprincipled men”; “led away” is rendered “carried away.”
NASB supplies “the” before “grace”; “to the day of eternity” is kept.
